auth_header_construction: Web/native shared: Authorization: Bearer {enterprise JWT} obtained via tokenRequester.getToken(productConfig) (bundle: 'Enterprise JWT toke…'); wallet/cashout calls: Authorization: Bearer {token} explicitly. Per-request client headers X-PE-Loc (location), X-PE-EP (eligibleProducts), X-PE-CN (clientName), X-PE-CV (client version fn p.s()), DK-Requested-Language (localization), X-Client-Page. Session: cookies with credentials:include (_root-session-prod/_home-session-prod JWT-ish, _csrf double-submit, Akamai _abck/bm_sz/STH/STIDN). WebSockets authenticate via query param ?jwt={token} (requestFormatter concat baseUrl+'?jwt='+token; validateUrl requires wss:// + jwt). Pick6 axios instance: baseURL=https://api.draftkings.com, withCredentials:true, default param format=json. Flag EXP-OSB-BE-RefactorJweAuthFlowEnabled indicates JWE auth flow refactor; dicetoken via GET /v2/auth/dicetoken.
attestation_or_pinning: iOS binary NOT inspected (IPA not obtained) → cert pinning & Apple App Attest NOT CONFIRMED for the iOS app. Web layer evidence: Akamai edge bot manager (_abck, bm_sz, GRN request-id; Akamai 403 Access Denied on API paths from datacenter IPs), HSTS max-age=2628000 includeSubDomains, X-Frame-Options/X-Content-Type-Options, CSRF cookie. CSP allowlists show third-party attestation/geo stack: geocomply (geocompliance.js v2/v3, wss plc-gc.com, wss.plc-gc.com), dv.socure.io (ingestion+network), js.radar.com + radar-verify.com, Singular, Sift, Braze, LaunchDarkly, Datadog RUM. Pick6 CSP also allows dkweb-pick6.isportgenius.com.au. Turnstile/Correlation API timeouts present in Pick6 config (TurnstileApiTimeout, CorrelationApiTimeout keys).

pickem_endpoint_shape: Pick6 (pickem) = api.draftkings.com as dkPublicApiHostname; unauth public routes under /public/pick6/v1|v2/... e.g. GET /public/pick6/v1/pickgroups/{pickGroupId}/category/{pickCategoryId}/pickcards?format=json&locationCode={geo}&isEIA={bool}&competitionId={id}; auth variants under /public/pick6/users/v1/...; entry flow POST /public/users/entries/v{1,2}/pickslip/proposal then POST /public/users/entries/v{2,3}/pickslip; contests GET /public/contests/v1/contests + /public/pick6/v1/contests/{contestKey}. Same-origin proxied (client-side) variants drop /public: /pick6/v1/... served through pick6.draftkings.com. Axios: baseURL dkPublicApiHostname, withCredentials=true, params.format=json. Response envelope uses ResponseStatus (destructured in useUserProfile bundle). Live probes from this host: 404 Not found on /public/... (api gateway likely routes by Host/geo) and 403 Akamai on /pick6/... proxy and /sites/US-PSX/... — shapes are from bundle endpoint table (p6b_endpoints-C5u8nxYj.js), not live-validated.
prop_endpoint_shape: Player props ride the sportsbook league/eventgroup API, not a separate props host: GET {sportsContentBff}v1/leagues/{eventGroupId}/categories/{category}/subcategories/{subcategory} (browser) where sportsContentBff=https://sportsbook-nash.draftkings.com/api/sportscontent/dkuswv/; SSR variant appends .json; legacy v5 shape GET https://sportsbook.draftkings.com/sites/US-SB/api/v5/eventgroups/{eventGroupId}.json?format=json&locale=en-us returns offerCategories→markets→outcomes with props tagged e.g. 'nba-player-props', 'multi-player-props-' (bundle evidence: getEventGroupByEventGroupCategorySubcategory, getOfferListForSubcategory, playerData.split('-')). Optional filters: &category=&subcategory=. Observed live: 403 Akamai from datacenter, so response schema NOT live-validated here.
